title: Design: Green success toast looks as designed
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: Your shop makes Net 30 the default, and you compare the green success message with the design.
  • You are an Admin user working at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Net 30 is active and is not the default for new customers.
  • The browser window is 1440 px wide, at 100% zoom.
    For example: a maximised window on a 1440 x 900 screen.
  • The design pictures ct-p1-10-saved.png, ct-p2-05-moved.png are attached to this case; open each at 100% zoom beside the screen.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page, Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click "⋯" on the Net 30 row.
  2. Click "Make Default for New Customers".
  3. Click "Make Default".
  4. Resize the browser window to 1536 px wide (for example, maximise it on a 1536 x 864 screen at 100% zoom).
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the row menu opens.
  • Step 2: the confirmation "Make Net 30 the default?" opens.
  • Step 3: a green toast opens at the bottom right of the page (as in ct-p1-10-saved.png): a white check-circle icon at the left, the first line "Net 30 is now the default" in bold, the line "New customers start on Net 30." below it, and a "Close" text button at the right.
  • Step 4: at 1536 px nothing overlaps, nothing is cut off and nothing needs a sideways scroll; the layout described above is unchanged, only wider.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11671 (Story 2, Row menu actions)

  • S2-R6: “On "Make Default", the term becomes the default, the "Default" tag moves to its row, and a success toast shows "{name} is now the default" with the line "New customers start on {name}." No customer, vendor or invoice changes.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Make Default confirmed | "{name} is now the default" / "New customers start on {name}." | Success toast with a Close action”
